Ghost button: small version is too large (36px height)
## Detailed description

The small ghost `Button` is too large (36px height). It should be 32px tall based on conversation: https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon/pull/3283#issuecomment-509766196

See: http://react.carbondesignsystem.com/?path=/story/buttons--default
